themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents designed to autonomously perform research tasks, discover information, and interact with systems to achieve research objectives.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, debug, review, and understand code, acting as assistants in the software development lifecycle.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad category of AI-powered platforms, software, and tools designed to facilitate, enhance, or automate various aspects of scientific and market research.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the use of AI-generated personas or simulated users to test designs, gather feedback, and conduct research without human participants.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Highlights AI capabilities in condensing large volumes of text, audio, or video into concise summaries for quick understanding and analysis.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the behavior, impact, and potential risks of AI-powered chatbots, including their use in customer service, information retrieval, and social interaction.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Covers AI applications that directly support or augment the work of UX designers and user researchers in their creative and analytical processes.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is used to gather, analyze, and interpret customer data to understand behavior, preferences, and needs.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Examines the use of AI to automate testing processes for software, hardware, and other products, improving efficiency and effectiveness.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Researches the effects of AI on employment, job roles, skill requirements, and the overall structure of the workforce.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
